subject.title: fix(marketplaces): allow trusted feed key rotation

question: Should a previously verified snapshot's persisted monotonic record remain authoritative for rollback comparison after its signing key is retired from the current trust set?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes the signed-feed trust boundary to permit key rotation, and the acceptable storage-provenance and tamper model requires repository-owner security intent rather than reviewer inference.

options.title: Approve accepted-state comparison
options.body: Accept persisted monotonic metadata for prior verified snapshots, provided the owner confirms it is written only after verification and scoped to the same feed identity.

options.title: Require old-snapshot re-verification
options.body: Keep rollback comparison conditional on validating the old snapshot with currently configured keys, accepting that retired-key rotations need another supported migration design.

recommendation.title: Approve accepted-state comparison
recommendation.body: Accept persisted monotonic metadata for prior verified snapshots, provided the owner confirms it is written only after verification and scoped to the same feed identity.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available technical routing candidate from the supplied context; an explicit marketplace/security owner should make the final policy decision.
